# KeepFloor

> The Etsy list price that still pays you. Put in one listing and it works out the
> whole published fee stack, then the lowest charmed price that survives Offsite Ads.

The arithmetic runs in the browser. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account.
Not affiliated with Etsy; the rates are the published ones, with the date they were read.

## What it answers

- What you keep at a given list price, against the target you set.
- The organic floor: the lowest price that works when no Offsite Ads fee applies.
- The ads-safe floor: the lowest price that still pays when the fee does apply.
- The survive-all floor: the price that holds through a sale and the ads fee together.

## Pages

- [Calculator](https://keep-floor.vercel.app/)
- [Catalog](https://keep-floor.vercel.app/#/catalog): price a whole shop from a CSV.
- [Sources](https://keep-floor.vercel.app/#/sources): every rate, with where it was published.
